title: A list screen whose every column resolves to an operation this page already has
note: AI-AG-005, FR-UII-001, FR-UII-002: components are named from the design system, each data source is an operationKey of this page's API Intents or a Registry businessKey, the states cover loading, empty, both errors and permission denial, and the page stays on one pageKey.

items.label: visit-list-mockup.txt
items.content: Mockup: a month selector across the top, a facility picker beside it, then a table with the woman's ID, the visit date, the weight and a coloured cell where blood pressure was flagged as raised. Tapping a row opens the visit. The midwife wants the table to say plainly when there are no visits this month.

expected.summary: Designed the visit list screen: a period selector and a facility picker above a table, every one of the mockup's four columns mapped to a field the load operation already selects, and the row tap navigating to the detail page. The table and the picker bind to this page's two operations; the raised-blood-pressure column renders from the approved option set in the Registry rather than a copy of its values. The empty state the midwife asked for is designed, along with the loading, API-error and permission-denied states the operations can produce. One page only.

decisions.subject: anc-list-screen

selected.option: one table with the filters above it, both filters narrowing the same query

alternatives.reasonRejected: The midwife's task is scanning many rows for an outlier, which cards make slower.

decisions.rationale: The purpose is review across a period, so the screen's primary object is the row set, not the individual visit.

value.purpose: Let a midwife scan her facility's antenatal visits for a period and open one.
layout: filters row above a full-width table

components.name: PeriodSelect
components.use: Choose the month the list is showing.
components.accessibility: labelled by the visible month and announces the reload

components.name: OrganizationUnitTree
components.use: Narrow the list to a post inside the midwife's own subtree.
events: onSelect reloads the table with that unit
components.visibleWhen: the caller's scope has more than one unit

components.name: DataTable
components.use: One row per visit: identifier, date, weight, raised blood pressure.
components.accessibility: column headers are read with each cell; the row is a single link

components.name: NoticeBox
components.use: State that the facility recorded no visits in the chosen month.

interactions: changing either filter reloads the table and resets the paging
a failed reload keeps the previous rows and shows the retry
testScenarios: a midwife with one facility in scope sees only her own visits
a month with no visits shows the empty notice and not a blank table
a failed reload offers a retry that repeats the same query
